scope: Selected lyrics-provider availability at skin entry points only. Existing addon code unchanged.
classification: Reproduced skin availability defect, not a newly removed Kodi builtin.

before.result: With CU LRC disabled after selection, both MusicOSD 701 and PlayerControls 609 set Lyrics=true and call RunScript on an unavailable addon ID. Two native non-existing-script ERROR lines.

sources.finding: RunScript looks up enabled addons; when that lookup fails it treats the supplied argument as a direct script path.
System.AddonVersion supports a translated dynamic Skin.String addon ID and resolves that label at runtime.

Version label implementation obtains the addon with OnlyEnabled::CHOICE_YES, so unavailable IDs yield no version. Native 6.7.6-to-empty transition when disabled confirms this; the adjacent generic source comment is not used as proof.
Published master retains dynamic addon-version translation.
Published master retains the enabled-only version lookup.

behaviour: MusicOSD uses actual availability before setting Lyrics, closing or dispatching start/force; unavailable selection opens the existing native typed lyrics selector.
PlayerControls uses its existing alternative-click selector when the provider is unavailable, rather than treating every nonempty ID as runnable.
The on/off toggle cannot start an unavailable provider; an already active Lyrics setting can still be turned off. Existing stop-only action retained.
Enabled CU service reuse and other typed lyrics dispatch remain as before.

native.cases: Disabled CU, a deliberately nonexistent ID and empty selection, each via MusicOSD and PlayerControls: six selector/cancel cases, no provider launch, Lyrics stays false. Visible radio enablement and clearing a stale true Lyrics flag additionally passed.

intermediate_attempts.finding: Positive functional flow passed but immediate helper shutdown after GUI restart produced one five-second invoker ERROR. Closing GUI and waiting for provider exit before Quit removes it in the final runs; exact internal timeout cause not proven. No addon change.

Helper queried radio enabled state while its parent group was still hidden/before a visible update. Final test opens the group and waits before inspecting/clicking. Exact GUI update timing not separately traced; no additional skin change.

cleanup: Own profile settings and music/addon database bytes/file sets restored. Positive provider probes verify unchanged copied addon files and standard source files. All isolated skin XML matches production after runs.
limits: Only CU LRC 6.7.6 is positively exercised as provider; no arbitrary third-party lyrics-provider execution, online scraper or rapid enable/disable race guarantee.
Missing ID is an explicit synthetic fixture value; no real addon was uninstalled.
Selector opening and cancellation tested; no automatic enable/install, choosing a new provider or language/aspect matrix approved.
Already available stop-only semantics remain; stale-state clearing tested with a controlled skin bool.
No claim that every named legacy source comment accurately describes current implementation.
